results.title: Spying Stars
results.overview: Scientist Anandi visits Hanuman Island to perform the last rites ritual for her father. She is immediately placed in quarantine in a remote hotel due to a pandemic caused by a machine-dominant world. When a mysterious star starts following her, she escapes and seeks refuge with a mother and her transgender daughter.

results.title: Sister Brother Manhole Cover
results.overview: A thriller-comedy about siblings stealing busts throughout Skopje.

results.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
results.overview: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

results.title: Welcome to Dolly's House
results.overview: A young YouTuber, Princess Maria, is determined to reveal the enigmatic secrets of Madame Dolly, a sorceress who can turn lifeless dolls into human beings. But as Princess Maria delves deeper, suppressed and painful memories resurface within her…

results.title: The Stalemate
results.overview: A robber and sheriff, out of bullets and far from town, must negotiate their way out of an absurd, unending chase in the Old West.

results.title: Faust
results.overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.

results.title: Rated
results.overview: Maggie must find the courage to own up to her behavior when she wakes to find every adult has received a YELP-like Star rating floating above their head. While most adults have a shining 4 or 5 stars, Maggie's got just 2.5.

results.title: Animol
results.overview: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

results.title: Omi
results.overview: An impulsive millennial mensch who gets possessed by the spirit of his dead Yiddish grandma.

results.title: Ralph's Perfekt Christmas
results.overview: To win back his wife, Christmas-obsessed Ralph concocts a crazy plan to kidnap the washed-up child star of his favorite Christmas movie. His scheme goes awry and spirals darkly out of control in an outrageous dark comedy with a horror twist that reveals two sides of one very desperate man determined to have his "Perfekt Christmas," no matter what - even if it lands him on the Naughty List.

results.title: Pyre
results.overview: In the Himalayan Mountain range, a rural village loses its inhabitants to the city’s allure while an elderly couple, Padam Singh and Tulsi, live in desolate isolation. Their days are filled with routine and occasional humour as they mask their loneliness. Their son’s absence gnaws at them, and when a letter arrives promising his return, it reignites their hearts with joy and anticipation. However, the reunion does not unfold as expected, shattering their hopes. As the film climaxes, the spectator is confronted with a more rueful plight, deeply engaging the audience’s empathy.

results.title: Bonds, Roots and Passions
results.overview: The story of three survivors of a refugee boat accident. Hazel, a young Syrian woman, finds herself trapped between cultural traditions and family responsibilities. Hamza, after being released from prison, struggles to reconcile with his past while trying to build a new identity and life for himself. Meanwhile, Khaled, an Afghan refugee, survives by working as a shepherd in a small village, but his love for the village headman's daughter clashes with the rigid traditions of the community.

results.title: Karateka
results.overview: At 39, Spanish karateka Sandra Sánchez sets her sights on Olympic gold in Tokyo, pushing her career toward its defining test. Her coach and life partner, Jesús del Moral, remains beside her throughout, a bond that turns each step toward the Games into a shared act of commitment.

results.title: Baltic UXO
results.overview: 1.6 million tons of unexploded military munition (UXO) were dumped into the Baltic and Northern Seas after the Second World War. A brooding and meditative cinematic journey observes the effects this has on nature and people around the Baltic.

results.title: Better Than A Shovel
results.overview: Carolyn and Howard are loving parents to their son Benny, but when they discover Benny may be developing unusual and dangerous behaviors, they devise a high risk mission in hopes of finding him a cure.

results.title: Bad Day at the Office
results.overview: A man with amnesia wakes up in a wrecked hotel room next to a corpse, triggering a dangerous conspiracy. He and a maid try to recover his memories and evade the police to uncover the mystery and survive those pursuing them.

results.title: Nakhrewaalii
results.overview: Sumit Mishra cross-dresses as a woman to win over his love interest, Paridhi.

results.title: Manduka
results.overview: A girl suffering from schizophrenia accidentally meets four criminals. Meanwhile in an hide and seek with Police and the criminals lies the mystery.

results.title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
results.overview: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. Who Killed Alex Odeh? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

results.title: In the Shadows
results.overview: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.
